questions.q: Who led Vietnam's independence movement and declared independence in 1945?
questions.why: Saigon was renamed after him.

questions.q: Which European country colonised Vietnam?
questions.why: It was part of French Indochina.

questions.q: In which year did the Vietnam War end with the fall of Saigon?
questions.why: The country was reunified in 1976.

questions.q: Which 1954 battle ended French rule?
questions.why: The Viet Minh besieged the French base.

questions.q: What was Ho Chi Minh City called before 1976?
questions.why: Many people still call it Saigon.

questions.q: Which sisters led a rebellion against Chinese rule in AD 40?
questions.why: They are national heroines.

questions.q: Which 1968 offensive surprised US and South Vietnamese forces?
questions.why: It turned US opinion against the war.

questions.q: Which general defeated the French at Dien Bien Phu?
questions.why: He later led forces against the US.

questions.q: Which last dynasty of Vietnam ruled from 1802 to 1945?
questions.why: Emperor Bao Dai was its last ruler.

questions.q: What were Vietnam's 1986 economic reforms called?
questions.why: The name means 'renovation'.

questions.q: Which general defeated Mongol invasions in the 1280s?
questions.why: He won at the Bach Dang River.

questions.q: Which Tay Son emperor defeated a Qing army near Hanoi in 1789?
questions.why: The victory is celebrated at Tet.

questions.q: Which former imperial capital in central Vietnam is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: The Nguyen emperors ruled from its citadel.

questions.q: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.why: It was founded over 1,000 years ago.

questions.q: Which bay is famous for thousands of limestone islands?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which old trading town is famous for lanterns and a Japanese bridge?
questions.why: Its old town is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: What is the world's largest known cave, in Phong Nha?
questions.why: Its full extent was explored in 2009.

questions.q: What is Vietnam's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is called the 'Roof of Indochina'.

questions.q: Which highland town was a French hill station?
questions.why: It is called the 'City of Eternal Spring'.

questions.q: Which Hanoi lake has a legend about a returned sword?
questions.why: Its name means 'Lake of the Returned Sword'.

questions.q: Which Lunar New Year festival is Vietnam's biggest holiday?
questions.why: Families gather and give lucky money.

questions.q: Which tunnel network near Saigon was used by Viet Cong fighters?
questions.why: They are now a tourist site.

questions.q: Which noodle soup is Vietnam's national dish?
questions.why: It began in northern Vietnam.

questions.q: Which baguette sandwich shows French influence?
questions.why: It is filled with meat, pickles and herbs.

questions.q: What is Vietnam's currency?
questions.why: Its notes are made of polymer.

questions.q: What is Vietnam's long tunic worn over trousers called?
questions.why: It is the national costume.

questions.q: Which river delta in the south is called the 'rice bowl'?
questions.why: It is famous for floating markets.

questions.q: Vietnam is the world's second-largest exporter of which crop?
questions.why: Robusta beans grow in the Central Highlands.

questions.q: What is the fish sauce at the heart of Vietnamese cooking?
questions.why: Phu Quoc's is famous.

questions.q: Which water puppet theatre is a northern Vietnamese tradition?
questions.why: The puppets perform on a pool of water.
